ex.en: Mrs. Parker greeted him with a smile.
ex.zh: 帕克太太微笑著跟他打招呼。

ex.en: Susan greeted her guests at the door.
ex.zh: 蘇珊在門口迎接她的客人。

ex.en: I didn't greet you because I mistook you for somebody else.
ex.zh: 我把你認成了別人，所以才沒有和你打招呼。

ex.en: I'd be very grateful if you could help me.
ex.zh: 如果你能幫我，我會非常感激。

ex.en: I'm very grateful for everything you've done for me.
ex.zh: 非常感謝你為我做的一切。

ex.en: I'm grateful to you for inviting me to the party.
I live with my mother, brother and my grandparents.
ex.zh: 我和媽媽，弟弟還有爺爺奶奶住在一起。

ex.en: Lucy was brought up by her grandparents.
Tom went to Boston to spend Christmas with his grandparents.
ex.zh: 湯姆去波士頓陪爺爺奶奶過聖誕節。

ex.en: I bought a handmade dried persimmon in Hsinchu. It tastes sweet but not greasy.
ex.zh: 我在新竹買了一塊手工柿餅，吃起來甜而不膩。

ex.en: This fried rice is too greasy.
A 10% gratuity is added to the bill.
ex.zh: 帳單會另加 10% 的小費。

ex.en: The graph shows a steady increase in prices.
ex.zh: 這張曲線圖顯示價格穩定上升。

ex.en: Plot the results on a graph.
